name: TableRow
description: A table row (<tr>) for the Table family. Works in <thead> and <tbody>; selected renders the selection surface. Presentational — semantics belong to the surrounding table.

usage.description: TableRow groups cells inside a Table's thead or tbody and carries the selected state visually while a real selection control (Checkbox) remains the source of truth.

ariaRequirements: native <tr> semantics; no ARIA of its own
selection is visual only (data-selected); the row's selection state belongs to a checkbox or the consuming app
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-27 — native tr; hover/zebra/selection tint are presentational; axe asserted inside a table in the unit test. 2026-08-04 — Phase 1 pass: light/dark/forced-colors verified in a real browser; axe clean across all stories x 3 modes; AT-tree and real-browser forced-colors evidence captured; keyboard sort cycle and selection driven by play stories at the Table composition level.

dense: table row; works in thead/tbody, selected surface, hover + zebra via the Table root

selected.description: Renders the selected surface and sets `data-selected`. Visual only.

forbiddenUse: rely on selected for semantics — pair it with a checkbox or aria-selected on the consuming structure
